title: Retention parameter and selector correlation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n\ge 0$, and let $\rho\in[0,1]$. The selector-based pair law on $\Omega^n$, with sign correlation $2\rho-1$, equals the retention-and-resampling pair law with retention parameter $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
